We need to propose retrosynthesis route for target SMILES: COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1

We must use templates ['1914393','1914394','1914395'] in this order. So three reactions sequentially, each using given template ID. Need to produce JSON tree: root is molecule (target), children list contains first reaction node with template_id 1914393, its children are precursor molecules (type mol). Then each precursor may be further broken down? The route must have at least 3 reactions, using those templates in order. Likely each reaction splits one bond.

We need to apply each template to target to get precursors. Use apply_template tool to see outcomes. Let's try apply template 1914393 to target.
